'''Yem Antayen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] employee of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the [[Director/Legends|director]] of the archeological team at [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
Yem Antayen's team was studying an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[mind prison]] hosting the consciousness of [[The Imprisoned One]], which they excavated from a long forgotten cave in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. The team also included [[Doctor/Legends|Doctors]] [[Di-go]], [[Lerek]] and [[Soprin]].<ref name="Cz found" />

Concerns around the nature of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Mind prison|device]] caused director Yem to implement a policy limiting physical access to the artifact, in favor of using [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and remote scanners instead. However, despite all the safety precautions, their tampering with the ancient device proved disastrous, and when [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Soprin]] attempted to open the mind prison, their equipment malfunctioned, and the prehistoric prisoner took control of the scientists' minds, turning their bodies into his puppets. Yem initiated lock down procedures, but a Czerka guard under the Imprisoned One's control killed him, turning the director into one of the Rakatan's puppets.<ref name="Cz found" />

Augmented with Rakatan nano-technology, walking dead body of Yem Antayen was still inside the [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|facility]] decades later, at [[3643 BBY]], when several individuals came looking for the base, after accessing archived holo-messages left by Yem and his co-workers, locked in data relays scattered across the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="Cz found" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yem Antayen appears in [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the final mission of the planetary quest-chain of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], for both Republic and Imperial players. While throughout the mission Yem is seen only through archived hologram recordings, his walking dead form can be found at the [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7]] compound. He can be killed, but it is not required by any mission.<ref name="Cz found" />
